edition: Reformatted edition, footer 'December 10, 2025' (cover: 'Reformatted 2001 and 2025, Latest Revision 2025'); section numbers are the new Chapter 4-7 numbering (Sec. 401, 501-506, 601, 603, 702). The task states a reorganized ordinance took effect Jan 9, 2026; the effective date was not verified from this file.
caveats: 'POD' in the use table means permitted subject to Plan of Development approval; 'S' = Special Use Permit; '*' = additional conditions. 'By right' in this file means P or POD.

Use-table column assignment (which district a P/S/POD belongs to) was reconstructed from PDF text x-coordinates; IND-1/2/3 mappings are consistent but spot-check visually, especially C-S and R-5 columns.

Energetics/explosives manufacturing is not addressed as a named use; the Warehousing definition excludes storage of explosive, corrosive or noxious materials, and Sec. 706 treats explosives facilities as incompatible near military airports.
Codes with no MCZO definition: IND-2p, IND-3p, AD-1, AD-2, AD-3.
Sec. 401.3.3 and Sec. 501/502 disagree on R-4 dwelling-unit density (1,000 vs 2,000 sq ft per unit).
Parcels may also be subject to Chapter 7 overlays (PAD, UPD, Military Airport Sec. 706) and case-specific conditions not in the ordinance.
Not legal advice; confirm with Maricopa County Planning & Development.
